chunks: Al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Fasting on the Day of Ghadīr Khumm is an expiation for sixty years."

key_terms.خُمٍّ: Khumm; the location associated with Ghadir
key_terms.سَنَةً: years; the duration referred to in the hadith
key_terms.سِتِّينَ: sixty; the number mentioned for the extent of expiation
key_terms.صَوْمُ: fasting; abstaining in worship for the sake of Allah
key_terms.غَدِيرِ: Ghadir; the named place and commemorated event
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: expiation; that which wipes away sins
key_terms.يَوْمِ: day; the specific occasion being referred to

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting on the Day of Ghadīr Khumm?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward of fasting on the Day of Ghadīr Khumm. It presents that fast as a means of expiation, showing the virtue of this day in Shia tradition.
